dialogues.en: Beep.
dialogues.text: Beep.

dialogues.en: "............Huhh, I need to get up..."
dialogues.text: "............Huhh, I need to get up..."

dialogues.jp: ピッ。
dialogues.en:
Just like in a cold winter, there's a strong force that
pulls me back to bed. It feels too good to stay in bed in
spring.
dialogues.text:
Just like in a cold winter, there's a strong force that
pulls me back to bed. It feels too good to stay in bed in
spring.

dialogues.en: I try my hardest with determination to get out of bed.
dialogues.text: I try my hardest with determination to get out of bed.

dialogues.jp: 「…………。あー、もう……起きるか」
dialogues.en: "Ugh...... It sucks......"
dialogues.text: "Ugh...... It sucks......"

dialogues.jp:
冬とは別の意味で、寝床の吸引力が強い。気持
ちが良すぎるのだ。
dialogues.en:
I complain to myself about how fast the morning's come. I
feel like the morning's come right after I closed my eyes
last night.
dialogues.text:
I complain to myself about how fast the morning's come. I
feel like the morning's come right after I closed my eyes
last night.

dialogues.jp:
｛てんじく／天竺｝まで目指せそうな鋼の意思でもって、布団
から這い出す。
dialogues.en:
I get out of my bed and walk towards where my school uniform
is. And I notice that both of my thighs hurt.
dialogues.text:
I get out of my bed and walk towards where my school uniform
is. And I notice that both of my thighs hurt.

dialogues.jp:
朝の訪れのあまりの早さに、ぶちぶちと文句が
もれる。
dialogues.en: I lightly pat them. They do hurt.
dialogues.text: I lightly pat them. They do hurt.

dialogues.jp:
何だか、目をつむったら朝が来てました、とい
う感じだ。

ベッドから降り、学生服へと向かう途中、両足
の｛もも／腿｝が痛む事に気が付いた。
dialogues.en: Am I having a muscle ache because I ran yesterday?
dialogues.text: Am I having a muscle ache because I ran yesterday?

dialogues.en:
"Hmmm...... I didn't have to try to think positive. It
really was good exercise for me."
dialogues.text:
"Hmmm...... I didn't have to try to think positive. It
really was good exercise for me."

dialogues.jp: とんとんと、軽く叩く。やはり、痛い。
dialogues.en:
I think about a plan to build up my muscle again which I'd
probably never do as I change to my school uniform.
dialogues.text:
I think about a plan to build up my muscle again which I'd
probably never do as I change to my school uniform.

dialogues.en: "Well, well, never mind, never mind."
dialogues.text: "Well, well, never mind, never mind."

dialogues.jp: まさか、走ったせいで？
dialogues.en: I say it like I'm a king talking to his follower.
dialogues.text: I say it like I'm a king talking to his follower.

dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん……プラスに思考しなくても、あれは
　いい運動になったのかもしれん」
dialogues.en: On the table is the breakfast I made.
dialogues.text: On the table is the breakfast I made.

dialogues.jp:
どうせ実行はしない肉体改造計画を練りつつ、
わしゃわしゃと着替える俺であった。
dialogues.en:
"There's nothing to do in the morning other than eat really
fast and get out for school. I don't mind you sleeping
late."
dialogues.text:
"There's nothing to do in the morning other than eat really
fast and get out for school. I don't mind you sleeping
late."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「す、すみません……すみませんでした……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ま、ま、苦しゅうない苦しゅうない」
dialogues.en: "I am... a maid...... and a maid has to......"
dialogues.text: "I am... a maid...... and a maid has to......"

dialogues.jp:
良く耳にするが、いまいち理解しがたい単語を
唱えつつ手を挙げる。
dialogues.en:
"You don't have to stick to the maid thing so much. I'm not
paying you anyway in the first place."
dialogues.text:
"You don't have to stick to the maid thing so much. I'm not
paying you anyway in the first place."

dialogues.jp:
テーブルには、俺の手になる朝食が並んでいる
のだった。
dialogues.en: "I am getting...... a reward......"
dialogues.text: "I am getting...... a reward......"

dialogues.jp:
「朝なんて、さくっとメシを食ったら、学園へ
　行くだけだからね。別に、寝坊してもいいよ」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「で、でも……私……私は……」
dialogues.en: "You let me stay here."
dialogues.text: "You let me stay here."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私は……メイドなのに……メイドだから……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, if you put it that way. But you don't even have your
own room."
dialogues.text:
"Well, if you put it that way. But you don't even have your
own room."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、そこまでこだわる必要はないと思う
　んだけど。報酬も払ってないし」
dialogues.en:
"I'd rather say you're losing more than you're gaining in
this situation. I mean, of course neither you nor me care
about that, though."
dialogues.text:
"I'd rather say you're losing more than you're gaining in
this situation. I mean, of course neither you nor me care
about that, though."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「報酬なら……いただいています……」
dialogues.en: "But...... But after all......"
dialogues.text: "But...... But after all......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en:
She sounds so sad and looks down. She hasn't touched her
breakfast yet.
dialogues.text:
She sounds so sad and looks down. She hasn't touched her
breakfast yet.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「この家に、置かせていただいてますから……」
dialogues.en: "I...... haven't done any work right......"
dialogues.text: "I...... haven't done any work right......"

dialogues.jp:
うつむき、切なそうな声を出す。頼子さんの朝
食は全くの手つかずだ。
dialogues.en: "Hmm."
dialogues.text: "Hmm."

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんってのは、余程きっちりしている人ら
しい。さて……。
dialogues.en: She seems to be a very decent and modest person.
dialogues.text: She seems to be a very decent and modest person.

dialogues.jp: ごくりとコーヒーを飲み込み、俺は切り出した。
dialogues.en: I take a big sip of my coffee and say,
dialogues.text: I take a big sip of my coffee and say,

dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、そこまで気にするんなら、目覚ましで
　も買ってこようか？」
dialogues.en: "If you really feel so bad, I can get you an alarm clock."
dialogues.text: "If you really feel so bad, I can get you an alarm clock."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「目覚まし……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "An alarm clock......?"
dialogues.text: "An alarm clock......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「さすがに、居間の時計はジリリっと鳴らない
　しね。俺も目覚ましは一つしか持ってないし」
dialogues.en:
"The clock in the living room isn't an alarm clock and I
have only one for myself."
dialogues.text:
"The clock in the living room isn't an alarm clock and I
have only one for myself."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「目覚まし時計さえあれば、普通に起きれると
　思うけど……どうする？」
dialogues.en:
"If you had one, I think you could get up on time...... Do
you want one?"
dialogues.text:
"If you had one, I think you could get up on time...... Do
you want one?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、は、はい……その……そうですね……」

こくこくと何度も頷き、憧れの先輩に告白でも
するように、目をぎゅっとつむった。
dialogues.en:
She nods many times and she closes her eyes tightly, as if
she's about to confess to her secret idol.
dialogues.text:
She nods many times and she closes her eyes tightly, as if
she's about to confess to her secret idol.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「で、では……お、お願いして……よろしいで
　しょうか……？」
dialogues.en: "S-So...... could you please get it...... for me......?"
dialogues.text: "S-So...... could you please get it...... for me......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、してして」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, with my pleasure."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, with my pleasure."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「それでは……、よろしくお願いします……」
dialogues.en: "Th-Thank you... so much for your kindness......"
dialogues.text: "Th-Thank you... so much for your kindness......"

dialogues.jp:
もし床に正座していたら、そのまま三つ指をつ
きそうな勢いのお辞儀だった。
dialogues.en: She bows as deeply as she can.
dialogues.text: She bows as deeply as she can.

dialogues.jp: ほんとーに、律儀なネコ耳さんだよな……。
dialogues.en: She's such a decent cat-ear girl......
dialogues.text: She's such a decent cat-ear girl......

dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ、任せてくれい」
dialogues.en: "Oh, okay. I'll get you one."
dialogues.text: "Oh, okay. I'll get you one."

dialogues.jp:
何となく気後れするものを感じつつも、俺はむ
しゃりとトーストを頬ばったのだった。
dialogues.en:
I feel a little intimidated for some reason, but continue
eating the toast.
dialogues.text:
I feel a little intimidated for some reason, but continue
eating the toast.

dialogues.jp: ◆目覚まし◆

寝坊したことを謝る頼子さん。そんなに気にす
る程の事はないと思うんだが、本当にきっちり
とした人らしい。

そこまで気にするならと、俺は彼女の目覚まし
を買ってくることにしたのだった。
